assignments.name: Introductory Python Exercise
assignments.description: Write Python programs to solve the 5 problems in the worksheet, submit as a PDF file

assignments.name: Mini Project: Calculator
assignments.description: Build a simple calculator program in Python supporting +, -, *, / with basic error handling

assignments.name: Group Project: Small Shop Management System
assignments.description: Pair up in teams of 2 and write a Python program to manage a small shop's inventory (add/remove/edit products, calculate sales), submit as a PDF with a work-division document

assignments.name: Quiz 1: Variables and Data Types
assignments.description: A short 5-question quiz on Python variables and data types, submit as a PDF file

assignments.name: Midterm Exam
assignments.description: Written midterm exam covering variables, conditionals, and loops. Graded directly from the answer sheet, no rubric used.

assignments.name: Quiz 2: Data Structures
assignments.description: A short quiz on Python Lists, Tuples, and Dicts, submit as a PDF file

assignments.name: Group Project 2: Meeting Room Booking System
assignments.description: Pair up in teams of 2 and write a Python program to manage meeting room bookings (book/cancel/check availability), submit as a PDF with a work-division document

assignments.name: Lab 5: Writing Functions
assignments.description: Write 3 Python functions per the given problems, with docstrings explaining each one, submit as a PDF file

assignments.name: Final Exam
assignments.description: Written final exam covering the whole semester. Graded directly from the answer sheet, no rubric used.

criteria.name: C1 · Program correctness / ความถูกต้องของโปรแกรม
criteria.description: Looks at the program's output matching the task.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: The program produces correct output for every task, including edge cases.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Output is correct on most tasks, but some cases fail — typically edge cases or unusual input.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Output is wrong on several tasks, or the program only works for the simple cases.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The program does not run, or its output is wrong almost everywhere and does not match the task.

criteria.name: C2 · Code readability / ความอ่านง่ายของโค้ด
criteria.description: Looks at naming, formatting and comments in the code.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Names are meaningful, formatting is consistent, and comments are used where needed.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Mostly readable, but a few names say too little or the formatting drifts in places.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many names are unclear, indentation is uneven and there are almost no comments, so a reader must guess what the code does.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The code cannot be followed — arbitrary names, and no structure or formatting at all.

criteria.name: C3 · Error handling / การจัดการ Error
criteria.description: Looks at handling of bad input and unusual cases.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Bad input and unusual cases are handled sensibly; the program never stops unexpectedly.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Common bad input is handled, but a few unusual cases still stop the program or give an unclear message.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Errors are handled in a few places only; badly formed input can still crash the program.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No error handling — even slightly wrong input stops the program.

rubrics.name: Grading Rubric: Group Project - Small Shop Management System

criteria.name: C1 · Feature correctness / ความถูกต้องของฟังก์ชันการทำงาน
criteria.description: Looks at the required features working correctly.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Every required feature works correctly and fits together as one system.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Most required features work, but a few fail in some cases or do not connect smoothly.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Several required features are missing or wrong, so the system cannot be used from start to finish.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Hardly any required feature works, or the system cannot run.

criteria.name: C2 · Program structure / การออกแบบโครงสร้างโปรแกรม
criteria.description: Looks at how the program is split into functions and modules.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Functions/modules are split sensibly; each part has a clear job and can be reused.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Split into functions reasonably, but some functions are long or do several jobs, and a little code is repeated.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Most of the code sits in a few functions or one file, with repetition in many places, so it is hard to change or extend.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No structure — all the code is in one block that cannot be reused or tested in parts.

criteria.name: C3 · Teamwork / การทำงานร่วมกันเป็นทีม
criteria.description: Looks at how work is shared and every member contributes.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: A clear work-split document exists, every member contributes, and the commit history agrees.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Work is split and most members contribute, but the work-split document is thin or commits cluster on a few people.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Some members barely contribute according to the commit history, and there is no clear work-split document.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Almost all the work was done by one person, with no evidence of splitting the work or collaborating.

rubrics.name: Grading Rubric: Quiz 1 - Variables and Data Types

criteria.name: C1 · Understanding of variables and data types / ความเข้าใจแนวคิดตัวแปรและชนิดข้อมูล
criteria.description: Looks at understanding of variables and data types.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Answers on variables and data types are correct and complete and show clear understanding.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Answers on variables and data types are mostly correct, but some points are incomplete or slightly misunderstood.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only part of variables and data types is understood; several core points are wrong or confused.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Almost none of the ideas asked about in variables and data types are understood.

criteria.name: C2 · Answer accuracy / ความถูกต้องของคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the accuracy of each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Almost every answer is correct, with no major mistakes.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Most answers are correct, with a few small mistakes.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many answers are wrong, including basic ones.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Most answers are wrong or left blank.

criteria.name: C3 · Reasoning and explanation / การให้เหตุผลและอธิบายคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the reasoning given with each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Reasoning is clear, in order, and based on the right principles.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Reasoning is given for most answers, but some skip steps or do not name the principle.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Reasoning is given for only some answers, and it is vague or unsound.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No reasoning — only bare answers.

criteria.name: C1 · Function correctness / ความถูกต้องของฟังก์ชัน
criteria.description: Looks at the functions returning correct results.

levels.label: Excellent

levels.label: Fair

levels.label: Needs Improvement

levels.label: Needs Improvement

levels.label: Fail

levels.label: Fair

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only some functions are tested, and edge cases are almost absent.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No test cases, or the tests cannot actually check the functions.

clos.text: Students can write Python programs to solve basic problems using variables, conditionals, and loops.
Students can design and use appropriate data structures (List, Tuple, Dictionary) for a given problem.
Students can write functions with proper error handling and documentation (docstrings).
Students can collaborate in a team to plan and develop a small program.
